discharged: For every actual level Q at least two and every coefficient field, there is an actual nonzero full native trivial-coefficient H1 eigenclass whose good-prime eigenvalues are exactly ell+1. Original SL2(Z) generator relations and matrix word positivity construct the required native cocycle. The existing actual permutation representation yields a genuine homomorphism taking the unit translation to one. The existing original Hecke transversal and native representative correction prove that cusp evaluation has scalar ell+1: the exceptional coset contributes ell and the translation cycle contributes one. The proved native H1 finiteness and prescribed common-eigenvector theorem give the class. No nonzero class, cusp functional, Hecke eigenvalue, finite cohomology or modular-generator cocycle existence is assumed.
